name: recording-rig-bridge
description: Sentinel-emitter bridge for the recording-rig Desktop backend (RDR-001). The model calls these tools at named beats; each call writes a /tmp/${SESSION}.* sentinel using the same contract as the CLI rig's hooks.
long_description: recording-rig-bridge is the coordination primitive for recording-rig's Desktop backend. It exposes four tools the model is instructed to call at named beats: rig_turn_end (turn boundary), rig_checkpoint (named milestone), rig_ask (gate answer from the per-session rig-config side-channel), and rig_emit (arbitrary named sentinel). Each call atomically writes a /tmp/${SESSION}.* sentinel (.partial + rename, no trailing newline) and appends to a JSONL transcript, byte-identical to the CLI rig's hook contract. This bundle is the Phase 1 SKELETON: tools are declared and dispatched with stub returns; sentinel writes, session resolution, and gate answers land in later beads. Tool names use underscores (rig_turn_end, not the RDR's prose form rig.turn_end) because dotted names collide with Claude's tool-namespacing (observed in RDR-001 P0.1).

tools.name: rig_turn_end
tools.description: Signal the end of the current turn. recording-rig waits on this sentinel to advance. (RDR prose: rig.turn_end)

tools.name: rig_checkpoint
tools.description: Mark a named checkpoint the recording asserts on. Arg: name. (RDR prose: rig.checkpoint)

tools.name: rig_ask
tools.description: Request the gate answer for an AskUserQuestion-style choice; returns the spec-dictated answer_index. Arg: options[]. (RDR prose: rig.ask)

tools.name: rig_emit
tools.description: Emit an arbitrary named sentinel with an optional payload. Args: name, payload. (RDR prose: rig.emit)
